description: Source code for ATM driver core functions specific to VR9 platform, including hardware reset, firmware download, initialization, start, stop, and version retrieval.

methods.name: vr9_reset_ppe
methods.description: Performs reset sequence for VR9 platform's PPE hardware components.

methods.name: vr9_pp32_download_code
methods.description: Downloads firmware and data code to the PP32 processor.

methods.name: vr9_init
methods.description: Initializes hardware components, including PMU, PDMA, mailbox, and shared buffers.

methods.name: vr9_start
methods.description: Downloads firmware and starts the PP32 processor.
